vocabulary.definition: able to live both on land and in water
vocabulary.example: Frogs are amphibious creatures that can survive both on land and in water.
In ancient mythology, Zeus was considered a powerful deity ruling over Mount Olympus.

vocabulary.definition: mythical beings with the ability to change their physical form
vocabulary.example: Werewolves in folklore are often portrayed as shape-shifters who transform from human to wolf form.

vocabulary.definition: a simplified language used for communication between speakers of different languages
vocabulary.example: During trade, merchants may develop a pidgin language to facilitate basic communication.

vocabulary.definition: viewing the world solely in terms of human values and experiences
vocabulary.example: Some argue that an anthropocentric perspective hinders our ability to understand the needs of other species.

vocabulary.definition: the quality of being humble or modest
vocabulary.example: Despite his success, he maintained a sense of humility and always treated others with respect.
